faqs.question: When is the Bromo Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bromo Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. This date applies to the full event, which includes the primary marathon distance of 42.195km as well as several shorter distance options held at the same venue in East Java, Indonesia.

faqs.question: Where is the Bromo Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at Plataran Bromo, located in Tosari, East Java, Indonesia. This venue serves as the central location for all five distance categories offered during the event, making it the starting point for runners participating in the 2026 edition.
